worldcombat.skill.firstimpression.summar: A bug-armour cannonball thrown the instant the user is sent out: extremely fast and the heaviest hit in the set, hammering the target back on contact. Once the user has taken any other action, this opening is gone.
worldcombat.skill.firstimpression.use.0: Land the heaviest lunge right after entering battle
worldcombat.skill.firstimpression.use.1: Cripple a foe as the fight opens
worldcombat.skill.firstimpression.use.2: Hammer a foe into a corner before it reacts
worldcombat.skill.firstimpression.descri: The full-body lunge deals about %1$s contact damage; the target's defence, type and crits are applied on the hit.
It leaps up to %1$s blocks at %2$s blocks per tick with a %3$s block radius, and knocks the target back %4$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.firstimpression.reckle: Reckless form: heavier, farther and with a harder shove, but a slower wind-up, longer recovery and cooldown, and harder to get back up.
Steady form: base power with a clean landing that stands back up quickly.

worldcombat.skill.firstimpression.growth: From level %1$s the slam power rises to %2$s.
From level %1$s the slam power rises to %2$s and the leap to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.firstimpression.prefer: On: heavier (x1.12), farther (x1.08) and with a harder shove (x1.25), but a 3-tick slower wind-up, 4 more recovery and 8 more cooldown, and harder to get back up. Off: a clean landing that stands back up quickly.
